mapper.sql: p.id, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.audit_type, p.audited_unit, p.leader_id, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.risk_level, p.description, p.create_time, u.real_name AS leader_name

LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.leader_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(1) AS issue_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_completed FROM audit_issue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) i ON i.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(1) AS evidence_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS evidence_confirmed FROM audit_evidence WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id ) e ON e.project_id = p.id
mapper.select:
SELECT , IFNULL(i.issue_total, 0) AS issue_total, IFNULL(i.issue_completed, 0) AS issue_completed, IFNULL(e.evidence_total, 0) AS evidence_total, IFNULL(e.evidence_confirmed, 0) AS evidence_confirmed FROM audit_project p
WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT , IFNULL(i.issue_total, 0) AS issue_total, IFNULL(i.issue_completed, 0) AS issue_completed, IFNULL(e.evidence_total, 0) AS evidence_total, IFNULL(e.evidence_confirmed, 0) AS evidence_confirmed FROM audit_project p
WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status IN (1, 2) ORDER BY p.risk_level DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status AS `key`, COUNT(1) AS `value` FROM audit_project WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
